_doc: The morning paper (MorningPaper, scripts/systems/paper.gd), shown when you wake after ending a day. {title} is a request's title, {n} a number of pieces, {name} a villager, {items} a shopping list. A request can have its own "headline" in quests.json. The paper's name comes from naps.json ("paper"), so a place can have its own.
done: {title}: job done, and the Sindaco was there for the photo
{title} finished; Sindaco calls it 'a personal triumph'
New Geometra completes {title}. Nobody fell in
built: Geometra puts up {n} new pieces; Sindaco says he supervised
{n} new pieces around the village overnight. Pigeons cautiously approve
Building spree: {n} new pieces, and not one of them on fire
quiet: Quiet day in the village. A pumpkin was admired
Nothing built yesterday. The Sindaco suspects a plot
Slow news day: the fountain is still a fountain
approval: The Sindaco's approval rating stands at {n} ({change} yesterday).
draft: The Geometra's draft is still short of {items}.
regrown: Overnight the ribboned trees and the quarry grew back.

weather.rain: Rain on the way today. Benches will be damp.
weather.mist: Morning mist in the valley; it clears by lunch.
